property_summary: For any caller address, the reference contract allows only the optimisticAsserter (address set at construction) to call assertionDisputedCallback; the mutant inverts that check so assertionDisputedCallback is callable by any OTHER address, which changes whether requestPrice (emitted event) can be triggered by the optimistic asserter — hence the reference always blocks non-optimisticAsserter callers while the mutant allows them, causing differing observable behavior after calls from non-optimisticAsserter addresses.
change_summary: Invert the access check in onlyOptimisticAsserter so that only callers not equal to optimisticAsserter can call functions using the modifier, altering whether requestPrice can be executed and thus its observable event emission.
